title: Harnessing a Game
author: logical_haze
selftext:
I love the new talk of harnesses in AI.

People beginning to realize utilizing AI in the right way is just as important as the model running it.

We've been asked so many times if our game is anything more than prompt engineering, and I thinking **Harnesses** captures the work and value added much better.

A game exists only by its restrictions, and as an AI game developer, we put those restrictions in place for both the AI and the users

replies.author: Merch_Lis
replies.body:
It's not new words, things like Claude Code and Open Claw called harnesses.

A harness is essentially an purposely designed functional environment which makes the model behave reliably in particular ways.  
You can run different models via the same harness and the harness would determine more than the specific model acting as an engine.
